templates.pat: Upload a complete species proteome to STRING, and we'll generate its interaction network and predict protein functions, including {{1}} terms and {{2}} pathways. Once uploaded, you can explore and analyze your proteome data through our {{3}}, access it programmatically via {{4}}, or {{5}} all predictions in bulk.

templates.pat: {{1}}{{2}} A flexible pipeline for RNA-seq analysis that integrates many existing tools for filtering and mapping reads, quantifying expression and testing for differential expression. iRAP is used to process all RNA-seq data in Expression Atlas.
templates.zh: {{1}}{{2}} 灵活的 RNA-seq 分析流程，整合多种现有工具完成读段过滤与比对、表达定量以及差异表达检验。Expression Atlas 中所有 RNA-seq 数据均由 iRAP 处理。

templates.pat: {{1}}{{2}} Search and download pre-packaged data from Expression Atlas inside an R session. Raw counts are provided for RNA-seq datasets and normalized intensities are available for microarray experiments. Protocols describing how the data was generated and sample annotations are contained within the downloaded R objects.
templates.zh: {{1}}{{2}} 在 R 会话中检索并下载 Expression Atlas 的预打包数据。RNA-seq 数据集提供原始计数，微阵列实验提供标准化强度。描述数据生成方式与样本注释的方案包含在下载的 R 对象中。

templates.pat: {{1}}{{2}} You can embed the Expression Atlas heatmap as a JavaScript widget on your site. You can build it from source or you can link directly to our built bundles. Instructions for both methods are provided in the GitHub repository. It is strongly suggested that you go through all the examples available in our showcase gallery .
templates.zh: {{1}}{{2}} 您可以将 Expression Atlas 热图作为 JavaScript 组件嵌入自己的网站。可以从源码构建，也可以直接链接我们已构建的包。两种方法的说明都在 GitHub 仓库中。强烈建议先浏览我们展示库中的全部示例。
